# Griffin Funding Reviews

> Ratings and review counts for Griffin Funding (Griffin Funding, Inc., NMLS #1120111), a licensed mortgage lender. Operated by Griffin Funding. Not an independent review site. Last checked 2026-09-27.

Griffin Funding has a weighted average of 4.8 out of 5 across 3,673 rated reviews on Google, Experience.com, WalletHub, Yelp, Zillow, and Trustpilot, and 3,733 public reviews in total across 7 platforms. BBB rates Griffin Funding A+ and is not in the star average, because A+ is a letter grade.

Weighted average = sum(star rating × review count) / sum(review count), shown to one decimal place. Only platforms that publish both a star rating and a review count are included.

Experience.com is counted as its own 4.88 from 1,600 reviews. The blended 4.81 from 3,073 recounts Google, Zillow, and Facebook and is not used, so those reviews are not counted twice.

The quotes on the page are a selection of Google reviews. They are not every review. Each quote links to its original post. Full profiles, including lower ratings and BBB complaints, are linked below.

## Platforms (checked 2026-09-27)

- Experience.com: 4.88 / 5, 1,600 reviews (https://www.experience.com/reviews/company/griffin-funding-1426)
- Google: 4.8 / 5, 991 reviews (https://share.google/5e6xAS2iXwbIUpnLL)
- WalletHub: 4.6 / 5, 757 reviews (https://wallethub.com/profile/griffin-funding-75917774i)
- Yelp: 4.6 / 5, 185 reviews (https://www.yelp.com/biz/griffin-funding-san-diego)
- Zillow: 4.9 / 5, 103 reviews (https://www.zillow.com/lender-profile/griffinfunding/)
- BBB: A+ letter rating, 60 reviews (https://www.bbb.org/us/ca/san-diego/profile/mortgage-lenders/griffin-funding-1126-172009171)
- Trustpilot: 4.7 / 5, 37 reviews (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/griffinfunding.com)
